title: Vanishing Point (CBC)
identity_notes: CBC speculative-drama anthology created and produced by Bill Lane and hosted by David Calderisi. The regular first two seasons mixed original Canadian radio plays with adaptations across science fiction, horror, thriller, psychological drama and other speculative forms. The frozen GRH set contains 24 selected broadcasts from historical episode #1 through #69, not a contiguous run.
